select defense_type, count (*) as times from situation_attack_message_history
scene_id = #{sceneId} and defense_type is not null
group by defense_type order by times desc

select create_time as time, source_id ,target_id, type as attack_type from situation_attack_message_history
scene_id = #{sceneId}
and type != 'media-animation'
order by create_time desc

select * from situation_attack_message_history
scene_id = #{sceneId}
and is_history = 0
order by create_time
